newsitem.title: USA: Corrpro says holders suit tentatively settled.
newsitem.headline: Corrpro says holders suit tentatively settled.

text.p: Corrpro Cos Inc said Monday a U.S District Court in Ohio granted preliminary approval of settlement in the securities class action and shareholder derivative action lawsuits filed after the announcement of the company's fiscal 1995 earnings.

The company and its insurer had agreed to pay $6.1 million in settlement of the suits, subject to court approval. The company recorded a pre-tax charge of about $2.4 million, relating to the settlement, during its second quarter ending September 30, 1996, the company said.
A hearing to consider final court aproval of the settlement has been scheduled for April 29, the company said.
